title: THE MIDDAY WATCH
NEHEMIAH TWO FOUR
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: sunlight pouring through rustic wooden window
dust motes dancing in warm midday sunbeam
quiet wooden desk with old open book in light
high noon sun shining through tall window blinds
serene empty room bathed in bright afternoon light
sunlit desk with quill and paper in quiet space
bright midday sun casting long shadows on floor
peaceful sanctuary bathed in warm noon sunlight

scenes.a: That urgent decision resting on your desk demands an answer you feel unprepared to give.
When the pressure rises and every second counts, remember you can speak directly to heaven.
Hear the record of a servant who threw a silent prayer upward before the king spoke again.
Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request?
So I prayed to the God of heaven.
scenes.sub: PRAYED TO THE GOD OF HEAVEN

scenes.a: Lord, grant us that same instantaneous trust when our hearts are heavy with tasks today.
Direct our steps in this quiet noon hour and keep our minds anchored in your peace.
In Jesus name we pray, amen.
